notes: Text now follows the theme. Headings were rendering at 22 pixels against a design drawn to a 17 pixel ceiling, because the app kept its own type scale and the theme had no way to reach it.

Spacing now follows the theme too. Roughly half the padding in Settings was measured in fixed pixels that no theme could change, which is why the layout stayed loose no matter which theme was selected.
Buttons now take the theme’s styling. They were using an older class name than the one themes are written against, so every button quietly kept the default look.
